title: Affine chart construction with local matching compatibility
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], U its punctured spectrum, q:Y→U and s:E→Spec C finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and D their supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let f:Fin t→A generate the maximal ideal. Give Gamma(E,top) its structural C-module action. There exist formal module glueing data X [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], a C-linear equivalence e:X.M′→Gamma(E,top), opens V_i of Y covering Y, and functions r_i:H0(X)→Gamma(Y,V_i) [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-H0]. For every h in H0(X), the sections r_i(h) agree on pairwise intersections. On O=Y×_U(Spec C restricted to U), with first projection p, p.app(V_i)(r_i(h)) equals the restriction to p inverse-image V_i of D.toCompleted.appTop(e(h.prime)). This is only a local chart construction: no global section or matching-ring function is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs (affine charts and overlap data); Tag 05EL, definition of H0. https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BLH and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05EL

proof.text: Every generator f_i belongs to the maximal ideal, so D(f_i) is contained in the punctured open U. Take V_i to be its inverse image under q followed by U inclusion. These opens cover Y: if a prime below the maximal ideal contains every f_i, the generating-ideal hypothesis forces it to equal the maximal ideal, contradicting membership in U. This also proves the empty-index case.
Apply the affine-chart realization theorem to get X, e and the chart identifications c_i, b_ij and d_i with their four restriction formulas. It does not assert any compatibility for H0 families.

Define r_i(h)=c_i(h.chart_i). Unfold the two intersections of kernels defining H0: the chart equations are alpha_ij(h.chart_i/1)=h.chart_j/1, and the prime equations are alpha_i(h.prime/1)=1 tensor h.chart_i. Apply b_ij to the first equations and its two restriction formulas to prove sheaf pairwise compatibility. Apply d_i to the second equations and its two restriction formulas to prove the completed local matching equality. Package these functions together with the previously proved cover.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BLH (affine chart construction) and 05EL (H0 equations); cover and passage from ambient equations to matching families proved in Lean

lean.statement:
theorem exists_formalGlueingData_prime
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let φ := algebraMap A C
    let g : CommRingCat.of C ⟶ Γ(E, ⊤) := (ΓSpecIso (.of C)).inv ≫ s.appTop
    letI : Module C Γ(E, ⊤) := Module.compHom _ g.hom
    let O := pullback q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)
    let p : O ⟶ Y := pullback.fst q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)
    ∃ (X : FormalGlueing.Data.{u, u, u} φ f) (e : X.M' ≃ₗ[C] Γ(E, ⊤))
      (V : Fin t → Y.Opens), ⊤ ≤ iSup V ∧
      ∃ (r : ∀ i, FormalGlueing.h0 φ f X → Γ(Y, V i)),
        (∀ h, Y.presheaf.IsCompatible V (fun i ↦ r i h)) ∧
        ∀ h i, p.app (V i) (r i h) =
          O.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : p ⁻¹ᵁ V i ≤ ⊤)).op
            (D.toCompleted.appTop (e h.val.1))
